tokens.description: Theme tokens intentionally kept compact for v1 while allowing meaningful visual tuning.

color.description: Core color controls for shell chrome, content surfaces, text hierarchy, borders, and status messaging.

chromePrimary.description: Primary shell/chrome color used for frame-oriented UI elements such as app bars and major shell accents.

accentPrimary.description: Primary accent color for emphasis and calls to action.

primaryText.description: Default high-legibility text color for primary content.

surfaceBackground.description: Global page/shell background color that establishes baseline visual mood.

panelBackground.description: Panel/card background color to visually separate sectional content from the overall surface.

borderPrimary.description: Primary boundary/separator color for section delineation and subtle structure.

controlBackground.description: Default background for interactive controls such as buttons, inputs, and selector chips.

controlBackgroundActive.description: Active/highlighted background for selected controls and control affordances.

controlText.description: Text color rendered on control backgrounds for high readability.

surfaceMuted.description: Muted supporting surface used for helper panels, placeholders, and collapsed blocks.

collapsedOutlineColor.description: Outline color for collapsed slot indicators.

collapsedFillColor.description: Fill color for collapsed slot indicators.

secondaryText.description: Secondary/supporting text color for metadata, helper text, and lower-priority labels.

statusSuccessText.description: Success-state text color for positive status messages and indicators.

statusWarningText.description: Warning-state text color for recoverable caution and degraded-state indicators.

statusErrorText.description: Error-state text color for failures and blocking problems.

echoMessageTextColor.description: Text color for the command handler echo/output message list.

echoMessageBackgroundColor.description: Background color for the command handler echo/output panel.

hudOutlineColor.description: HUD card outline color for in-scene presentation overlays.

hudBackgroundColor.description: HUD card background color for in-scene presentation overlays.

hudTextColor.description: HUD message text color for in-scene presentation overlays.

hudManualDismissButtonColor.description: Manual-dismiss CTA color for HUD overlays that require a click to continue.

typography.description: Typography tokens for readable baseline text plus optional display style character.

textFontFamilyPrimary.description: Primary UI text font stack used across most interface content.

textFontFamilyDisplay.description: Optional display/headline font stack used for branded or expressive headings.

hudFontFamilyHeader.description: HUD header/action font stack used for dismissal hint text and compact HUD labels.

hudFontFamilyBody.description: HUD body font stack used for in-scene narrative/message text.

shape.description: Shape token(s) that define the default curvature personality of UI components.

borderRadiusBase.description: Default border radius in CSS pixels for cards, panels, and controls.

borderThickness.description: Primary border stroke thickness in CSS pixels for themed borderPrimary outlines.

collapsedComponentThickness.description: Collapsed slot indicator thickness in CSS pixels, used across collapse axes.

spacing.description: Spacing token(s) used as a rhythm base for margins, gaps, and paddings.

baseUnit.description: Base spacing unit in CSS pixels used as a multiplier for layout spacing rhythm.
